title: AJ 37 Viggen (attack version)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The AJ 37 is the original attack version of the Swedish Viggen, a canard-delta jet (a big delta wing with small extra wings in front) that flew from roads and short strips from 1971. The AJS 37 that DCS models is the same aircraft after an update in the 1990s, which changed the computer, the data cartridge and the weapons, not the switches the pilot touches. So this guide uses the AJS 37 cockpit: analogue instruments, a head-up display over a round radar screen and a separate radar handle on the left.
